connectingThread: Both strategies are responses to threat presence — counterattack uses the fight to create advantage, deterrence prevents the fight from starting. The diagnostic question is whether the opponent has already moved (counterattack) or is still deciding (deterrence).
priorChapterRelationship: Ch3 established the four-discipline defensive menu's first two disciplines (perfect economy, nonengagement). Ch4 adds the remaining two: using the attack against the attacker (counterattack) and eliminating the fight via credible threat (deterrence).

reversalFlags.counterattack: Parasitic on being attacked; fails against attrition opponents who never commit to an exposed strike.
reversalFlags.deterrence: Defensive/consolidating only; wrong discipline during seasons that require taking new ground.
